sourceFile: 19. TIU C11-20  Report TestDont use VP press Jig ( Frame+ VP) 2025.12.24_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid comparable evidence but misidentifies the primary changed factor and mishandles tension data.
issues: Primary changed factor should be use vs no use of VP press jig, not Normal vs TIU C11-20R.
TIU C11-20R is model context, not the changed condition.
Tension outcome is not a valid two-condition comparison; normal row has no samples.
Tension spec and sample count are extracted incorrectly.
Changed/test condition is placed as subgroup instead of main factor.
correctionPlan: Set baseline to Normal use VP press jig and changed condition to Test no VP press jig.
Move TIU C11-20R to subgroup/model context.
Keep defect and function outcomes under the jig-use comparison.
For tension, cite both test and normal rows or mark as test-only with no normal data.
Correct tension spec to 0.4 and sample count to the measured 10 values.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist and are citeable, but are not sufficient until factor labels and tension evidence are corrected.
